what: piece of cha chaan teng kitchen equipment
scale: One scale for all, the same as the board's counters (the prep counter there is about 1.5 m long and waist-high).

items.name: noodle_boiler
items.look: a stainless steel Cantonese noodle boiler about 1.2 m long and waist-high: a deep tank of steaming water with three wire noodle baskets on long handles hanging in it, a ladle resting on the edge; its long front faces down-left

items.name: griddle
items.look: a stainless steel flat-top griddle about 1.2 m long and waist-high, two eggs frying and a slice of golden French toast on its plate, a steel spatula beside them; its long front faces down-left

items.name: toaster
items.look: a commercial conveyor toaster (a steel box with a wide slot and a slice of bread going in) on a short steel stand; its front faces down-left
